theorems.name: Submission.rsdic_tl_excess_density_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A B : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (r₀ C r₁ : ℝ), 0 < r₀ → μHE[n] (B ∩ closedBall x r₀) ≠ ∞ → 0 < r₁ → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r₁ → μHE[n] (A ∩ closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)) → (∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), μHE[n] ((B \ A) ∩ closedBall x ρ) ≤ ε * μHE[n] (B ∩ closedBall x ρ)) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => μHE[n] ((B \ A) ∩ closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
